title: appendGeometry
body:
## appendGeometry

Appends several polygonal (vtkPolyData) inputs, such as surfaces, lines or point clouds, into one polydata without merging points. Only point and cell arrays common to all inputs survive. Use it to combine surface parts for a joint export or surface filter; use append for mixed dataset types.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Shared edges between parts keep duplicate points; run clean afterwards for a connected surface (needed for consistent normals or connectivity).

Native constructor: `AppendGeometry`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "appendGeometry",
  "inputs": {
    "input": [
      "UPSTREAM_input"
    ]
  }
}
```
